Mixing **Aleve (naproxen)** and alcohol is  [Highlight start] **not recommended** [Highlight end] , especially in large amounts or regularly, because both irritate the stomach lining and raise the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXISkJacDARi6vNken0RaNJZcmKNXoUEulyGELKKjTR1Yyc0a1gIa-ZG1essYiJ9wVMI5QJwBj2uUUCBmlKobiD1KrqCXjJOcyFcRaptxJVEydB41fwHTXjSnhDEXgUPNghZ-MUEwmhhDs2k3nGlGKUeicEwriYfM)

### Key Risks

- **Stomach bleeding and ulcers:** Naproxen blocks protective stomach prostaglandins, while alcohol irritates the stomach lining and increases acid. Together, they heighten the chance of gastritis, ulcers, and severe bleeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXqVxjKTdL3MlPBhFsu5iJ5SnKTL1p0mOnEflxW49OxG4lB1X4D4IZtyzd-57g_9DfBp2esehVxC75xzAVOfXC337o5nuM1xaZX92HrUGiGN9P2dZANNR2A43KYYGnYzzoSveshbeIMBOGfvjTpnKS5KIcJs1yIK-3DA)
- **Organ strain:** Combining them can add stress to your kidneys and liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXqVxjKTdL3MlPBhFsu5iJ5SnKTL1p0mOnEflxW49OxG4lB1X4D4IZtyzd-57g_9DfBp2esehVxC75xzAVOfXC337o5nuM1xaZX92HrUGiGN9P2dZANNR2A43KYYGnYzzoSveshbeIMBOGfvjTpnKS5KIcJs1yIK-3DA)
- **Worsened side effects:** You may experience stronger stomach upset, dizziness, or drowsiness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2cXBqUCc5LCRhBqK-K-ezhROx8-IZYA6Dx-FkIfuey7OqKgsBRza3l4-y3Y-BAf5pfwumfGQGs3zuW9-1ruCbgfwLHbMornZUKb1coNINjX3bikI2Ytd6tFf7ZZ-jE1l_D2rXTypUvlnwytLqe9TxCQyad7C)

### Safer Practices

- **Avoid drinking while taking Aleve:** The safest approach is to skip alcohol while using naproxen. For details on interaction warnings, see [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXWeI3mACJrYZFx-Aa8iBO7I6qnxAkUC27q-pPFHfg02xKSjqs8MC5f-6v2Nn_NjtUoBlT9LwyTgHRV3liA8P6NLo9lPsAs7--5f8xO0S9fDu-4Dh6KVTEZbOpOHdY5IOBkW10q_9cVbQi4ypbIhNDlEw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXISkJacDARi6vNken0RaNJZcmKNXoUEulyGELKKjTR1Yyc0a1gIa-ZG1essYiJ9wVMI5QJwBj2uUUCBmlKobiD1KrqCXjJOcyFcRaptxJVEydB41fwHTXjSnhDEXgUPNghZ-MUEwmhhDs2k3nGlGKUeicEwriYfM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXWeI3mACJrYZFx-Aa8iBO7I6qnxAkUC27q-pPFHfg02xKSjqs8MC5f-6v2Nn_NjtUoBlT9LwyTgHRV3liA8P6NLo9lPsAs7--5f8xO0S9fDu-4Dh6KVTEZbOpOHdY5IOBkW10q_9cVbQi4ypbIhNDlEw)
- **Consider timing:** Naproxen has a half-life of roughly 12 to 17 hours and takes about 3 to 4 days to clear fully. Many clinicians suggest waiting at least 12 to 24 hours after a dose before drinking, if at all.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXqVxjKTdL3MlPBhFsu5iJ5SnKTL1p0mOnEflxW49OxG4lB1X4D4IZtyzd-57g_9DfBp2esehVxC75xzAVOfXC337o5nuM1xaZX92HrUGiGN9P2dZANNR2A43KYYGnYzzoSveshbeIMBOGfvjTpnKS5KIcJs1yIK-3DA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF10eOUQ9gHQxHP10Sc0BcVdrH86ymsTDKMXSJTspqyqy3xsekH9a6OG6tMFkGejpRFNbrCZ6hP_Gx7SGNkbwiS49uorxPxKeALrAgpKMyIpmPLin2XDzXB8D83UpID5omH9EcPzTkhJJdgA6yta_qP2591Xu5vFd3f0u8x1MqtJg5BWce)
- **Watch for higher risk:** Risks climb if you drink heavily, take other NSAIDs (like ibuprofen or aspirin), have a history of ulcers or GI bleeding, have kidney or liver issues, or are over age 60.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXqVxjKTdL3MlPBhFsu5iJ5SnKTL1p0mOnEflxW49OxG4lB1X4D4IZtyzd-57g_9DfBp2esehVxC75xzAVOfXC337o5nuM1xaZX92HrUGiGN9P2dZANNR2A43KYYGnYzzoSveshbeIMBOGfvjTpnKS5KIcJs1yIK-3DA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXGewJ_kQaRIeq2KgGD41ilE9gKukdbncdzOuQNVyeV1xSToUf2iQlhZESyyYMePGaCQtJRQwCl0iYnyA-w7GhxxhtZipuL1DD-wGTXAc7xxCf5cFgeDKePrmMbZBuPDcTWzmdLkSFRKNX1LiFgg)

### When to Seek Immediate Care
Stop taking Aleve and get urgent medical help if you notice signs of stomach or intestinal bleeding, such as:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXWeI3mACJrYZFx-Aa8iBO7I6qnxAkUC27q-pPFHfg02xKSjqs8MC5f-6v2Nn_NjtUoBlT9LwyTgHRV3liA8P6NLo9lPsAs7--5f8xO0S9fDu-4Dh6KVTEZbOpOHdY5IOBkW10q_9cVbQi4ypbIhNDlEw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k)

- Black, tarry, or bloody stools
- Vomiting blood or material that looks like coffee grounds
- Severe or persistent stomach pain, faintness, or lightheadedness[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXWeI3mACJrYZFx-Aa8iBO7I6qnxAkUC27q-pPFHfg02xKSjqs8MC5f-6v2Nn_NjtUoBlT9LwyTgHRV3liA8P6NLo9lPsAs7--5f8xO0S9fDu-4Dh6KVTEZbOpOHdY5IOBkW10q_9cVbQi4ypbIhNDlEw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX2cXBqUCc5LCRhBqK-K-ezhROx8-IZYA6Dx-FkIfuey7OqKgsBRza3l4-y3Y-BAf5pfwumfGQGs3zuW9-1ruCbgfwLHbMornZUKb1coNINjX3bikI2Ytd6tFf7ZZ-jE1l_D2rXTypUvlnwytLqe9TxCQyad7C)

For guidance tailored to your situation, check with a doctor or pharmacist, as noted by [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXbwCfR01RSesyX2S4GXfqBh019Z3UZe_Ly36fxlq9eFAcOLWtxrSyAizMm4VrLeSQmEThTsZVc89pwB68kby-Rw4MT2iYwIrdHjQHShF2g9gvkFsQO3BeYChTVaxJPasKEZ2ABcsgzzU-7128NDkBf7k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXx6SbSwKOXGrqcr60q5fwv5Q9s6fc--Y0ZqoFN3Mhbg5Qs16mmCkhhnN848HhXc_9X0-9Kz9O23kvFa2JWX4CBOLU1ZnewTedYSBtlWtpYocT3efKbov03j8o2dtbm6kKoQ112KsiwQ)If you'd like more specific information, share:

- **Whether you've already taken Aleve and had a drink** (and any symptoms you feel)
- **How much or how often** you drink alcohol
- **Any relevant health history** (such as stomach ulcers, liver/kidney issues, or other medications)
